assumptions: Turner 2004 nearest-neighbour parameters; the scaffold is one of the published ones we ship.
limits: A minimum-free-energy fold, not an ensemble; co-transcriptional folding is not modelled.
Without a sourced scaffold for the nuclease it folds the spacer alone and says so.
bio.jane/contract.question: Does a spacer base-pair into its sgRNA scaffold, and what does the whole guide RNA fold into?

description: Fold a guide RNA — the spacer alone, and the whole sgRNA on a real published scaffold — and report which bases of the spacer pair with the scaffold. A spacer that base-pairs into the scaffold disrupts the structure Cas9 binds, which is a physical cause of a dead guide rather than a score. Every free energy is a minimum-free-energy fold under the Turner 2004 nearest-neighbour parameters, in kcal/mol, cross-checked against ViennaRNA 2.7.2.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

nuclease.description: picks the scaffold published for that nuclease. Values: SpCas9 (SpCas9: NGG (3')), SpCas9-NG (SpCas9-NG: NG (3')), SpG (SpG: NGN (3')), SpRY (SpRY: NRN (3')), xCas9 (xCas9: NG (3')), SaCas9 (SaCas9: NNGRRT (3')), SaCas9-KKH (SaCas9-KKH: NNNRRT (3')), AsCas12a (AsCas12a: TTTV (5')), LbCas12a (LbCas12a: TTTV (5')), enAsCas12a (enAsCas12a: TTTV (5')).

sg_rna.description: also fold the full spacer+scaffold sgRNA, not just the spacer.

name: fold_guide

scaffoldIntact.description: whether the scaffold still folds as published once the spacer is attached. Null when no scaffold is published for this nuclease: false would read as a disrupted scaffold

scaffoldName.description: which published scaffold was used. Null when no scaffold is published for this nuclease

sgRna.description: the full sgRNA fold, when a scaffold is published for this nuclease

spacer.description: the spacer's own fold: sequence, dot-bracket structure and free energy

spacerScaffoldPairs.description: how many spacer bases pair INTO the scaffold — every one of them disrupts the structure Cas9 binds. Null when no scaffold is published for this nuclease

unavailable.description: why nothing was folded, when no scaffold is published for this nuclease; null when the fold ran
